$comment: The only place model ids live. Everything else reads them from here (Terraform, the agent image). A model's own profilePrefix overrides the top-level one (Haiku for Ask Clip Factory uses the EU geo profile, docs/CONTRACTS.md §19.5); profileRegions lists that profile's destination regions, for IAM. embeddingModel.modelId is in-Region and used as is (never prefixed with profilePrefix).
